messages:
alisha: Hey - anyone know where the KV/prefix cache hit-rate dashboards live? Need to triage the 10/02 spike and want to correlate with traces + logs. Also the `KVCacheLowHitrate` alert went noisy :/

ben: Grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.company/d/serving-kv/kv-observability?orgId=1
Panels to look at: "KV Cache Hit Rate (by prefix)" and "KV Cache Request Rate".
PromQL for overall hit rate:
```
(sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{env="prod"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m]))) * 100
```
To filter for prefixes: add `prefix=~"^user-.*"` in the selector.

maria: Logs are in Loki (job=serving). Example query to surface prefix misses:
```
{job="serving"} |= "prefix_cache" |= "miss" | json | prefix
```
You can then filter `| prefix=~"user-.*"` to narrow. Link: https://loki.redwood.company/explore?query=%7Bjob%3D%22serving%22%7D%20%7C%3D%20%22prefix_cache%22%20%7C%3D%20%22miss%22

samir: Traces are in Tempo; search for span attr `component="kv.cache"` or tag `cache.prefix`. Example trace link (replace trace id): https://tempo.redwood.company/trace/TRACE_ID?service=serving
If you want a quick sampling: use `trace.search` with tag `kv.cache:miss` to find requests that fell back to main store.

infra-bot: ALERT: `KVCacheLowHitrate` fired for prefix=user-*.alert_rule=KVCacheLowHitrate severity=warning starts_at=2026-10-02T14:12:03Z

liam: I can take the alert tuning. Current rule is pretty sensitive (1m evals?). Suggestion to reduce noise: evaluate over 5m and require > 3 evals before firing, and add min-request-volume gating. Proposed expr (per-prefix):
```
( sum by(prefix)(rate(kv_cache_misses_total{env="prod"}[5m]))
  / sum by(prefix)(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m])) ) > 0.25
```
then `and sum by(prefix)(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) > 50` to avoid low-cardinality flaps. Thoughts?

alisha: That sounds reasonable. Our SLO for prefix hit-rate is ~85% for user-* during steady state. The noisy prefixes are small-cardinality test prefixes + a few route-* prefixes.

ben: +1 to the request-volume gate. Also add a mute for `staging` env in the alert rule: `env!="staging"`.

maria: I'll attach a couple of Loki queries and sample log lines to the incident ticket so liam can correlate before changing rules.

liam: Cool - I'll open a PR against `infra/alerts/kv-cache.yaml` with the 5m window + volume gate + env exclusion and ping for review. If anyone has a specific prefix list to exclude, drop them here.

alisha: Thanks all. I'll paste the trace ids into the ticket once I have them. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
